limits: Operating income is not published as a line in the income statement, so operating_income and operating_margin are not_applicable under the rules. Segment income before tax (Innovative Medicine 22,266; MedTech 4,113) is not operating income and was not substituted.
The company's 'net debt' of 27.8 billion uses cash plus current marketable securities. The fact sheet uses the defined cash-only basis, giving 28,224. Check which basis the analyst needs.
Capex is reported as a positive amount (4,832), though the cash-flow statement shows it as an outflow.
The 2025 balance sheet shows no non-controlling interests, so shareholders' equity equals total equity. Confirm this against the full statements if the analyst's definition differs.

Pages for the balance sheet (p.43), income statement (p.44), equity statement (p.46) and cash-flow statement (p.47) are taken from the page footers in the text. Note 7 page references are approximate because the text extraction is mixed.

Total financial debt includes commercial paper and local borrowings inside 'Loans and notes payable', as defined in the rules. The split of 8,495 between short-term borrowings and current debt is per Note 7 (about 8.5 billion total, of which 2.0 billion is current long-term debt).

Fiscal 2025 includes a reversal of about 7.0 billion of talc reserves and an 0.8 billion Auris judgment. These affect net income and EPS comparability; the report does not give an adjusted figure, and none was used.
The 2023 comparative figures are not recast for discontinued operations (Kenvue). Only 2025 and 2024 were used for computations.
